name: com.xmlvalid/xmlvalid
title: xmlvalid
description: Validate XML and e-invoices; write XRechnung, Peppol, ZUGFeRD, KSeF, FatturaPA, Facturae, e-SLOG

tools.name: validate_xml
tools.description: Validate an XML document with xmlvalid: well-formedness, an XSD, DTD or RelaxNG schema, and for e-invoices the Schematron business rules of EN 16931, Peppol BIS, XRechnung, Factur-X and national formats. Pass the document as `xml` (its text) or `url` (a public http(s) address), and a `schema`: a catalog slug from search_schemas, a saved schema ("@orders-v3"), or "auto" to use the e-invoice profile the document names. Without a schema only well-formedness is checked. Returns valid, errors and warnings with line, column, message, rule and a help_url explaining each. Counts as one API validation of the account's monthly quota.

xml.description: The XML document itself. Use url instead for a document on the web.

url.description: A public http(s) URL of the document, fetched by xmlvalid.

schema.description: A catalog slug (see search_schemas), "@<name>" for a saved schema, or "auto" for the e-invoice profile the document names. Leave out to check well-formedness only.

name.description: A file name to show in the result, such as invoice-42.xml.

rules_version.description: Pin Schematron rule sets to releases, as rule-set@version, comma-separated (peppol-bis-3-ubl@3.0.21): the call fails with rules_version_mismatch when one has moved on. The result's rule_sets lists the releases that ran.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a pending status to poll with get_validation; 30 when left out, 0 to return at once.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Write an e-invoice from structured data and check it: XRechnung 3.0 (UBL or CII), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X EN 16931 or EXTENDED, a French CTC invoice, the Dutch NLCIUS / SI-UBL 2.0 (UBL or CII), Poland's KSeF FA(3) (the seller's NIP; another currency than PLN needs exchangeRate, PLN for one unit; prepaid needs prepaidDate) or Italy's FatturaPA 1.2 (buyer.recipientCode, the SdI code, or buyer.pec; an Italian buyer's codice fiscale as buyer.taxNumber; seller.taxRegime, RF19 for the flat-rate scheme) or Spain's Facturae 3.2.2 (the seller's and a Spanish buyer's NIF as vatId or taxNumber; a public administration buyer, NIF P, Q or S, needs buyer.dir3 {accounting, managing, processing}; euros only; prepaid needs prepaidDate; unsigned, the user signs it for FACe) or Slovenia's e-SLOG 2.0 (the seller's and the buyer's tax number as taxNumber or a Slovenian vatId; no attachments), with xmlvalid's e-invoice generator, then validated against the profile's schema and business rules. Pass `invoice` with `profile` (xrechnung, peppol, zugferd, france, nlcius, ksef, fatturapa, facturae, eslog), `lines` (name, quantity, unit, price, category, rate) and what the invoice needs: number, issueDate, dueDate, currency, buyerReference (the Leitweg-ID for German public buyers), seller and buyer (name, street, city, postcode, country, vatId, endpoint {scheme, id}; seller.contact {name, phone, email}), payment (means, iban, bic). Amounts are worked out in decimal. Returns the validation (result with errors and warnings), `invoice` (the totals as written and `ignored`, fields that were not taken) and `xml`, the written invoice, to give the user or fix and write again. Counts as one API validation of the account's monthly quota.

invoice.description: The invoice in the e-invoice generator's fields, as POST /api/v1/invoices takes it (https://xmlvalid.com/docs/api#invoices): profile (xrechnung, peppol, zugferd, extended (ZUGFeRD EXTENDED), france, nlcius, ksef, fatturapa, facturae, eslog), syntax (ubl or cii), type (380 invoice, 381 credit note, 389 self-billed invoice for xrechnung, zugferd, extended, france), number, issueDate, dueDate, currency, exchangeRate (KSeF), buyerReference, orderReference, precedingInvoice, precedingDate, precedingKsefNumber (KSeF), note, paymentTerms, delivery {date, start, end}, seller {name, street, city, postcode, country, vatId, taxNumber, registration, taxRegime, endpoint {scheme, id}, contact {name, phone, email}}, buyer {name, street, city, postcode, country, vatId, taxNumber, recipientCode, pec, dir3 {accounting, managing, processing} (Facturae), endpoint}, payment {means, iban, bic, accountName, reference}, lines [{name, description, quantity, unit, price, category, rate, itemId}], charges [{charge, reason, amount, category, rate}], prepaid, prepaidDate (KSeF, Facturae). Numbers may be numbers or decimal strings.

rules_version.description: Pin Schematron rule sets to releases, as rule-set@version, comma-separated.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the check before returning a pending status to poll with get_validation; 30 when left out.

tools.name: get_validation
tools.description: The status and result of a validation started with validate_xml that was still running when it returned (status "queued" or "running"). Results are kept for 24 hours.

tools.name: search_schemas
tools.description: Search xmlvalid's catalog of official XML schemas (UBL, CII, Peppol, XRechnung, Factur-X, ISO 20022, HL7, sitemaps…) by name, namespace, root element or area. Returns each schema's slug to pass to validate_xml, its version and the business rules it checks. No sign-in or API key needed.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "peppol invoice", "xrechnung cii" or "pain.001". Leave out to list the first schemas.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Explain an XML parsing or schema validation error message: what it means, why it happens and how to fix it, with an example. Understands libxml2 (xmllint, PHP, Python lxml, xmlvalid), Java (Xerces cvc-* codes, SAXParseException) and .NET (System.Xml) wording; paste the message as reported, stack trace prefix included. No sign-in or API key needed.

message.description: The error message, as the parser or validator reported it.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain an e-invoicing business rule by its id, such as BR-CO-15, BR-DE-1, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001 or a national CIUS rule: its message, level, the rule sets it belongs to, why invoices fail it and how to fix them. No sign-in or API key needed.

id.description: The rule id as the validator reports it, such as BR-CO-15.
